message: 親密に親睦会

name: Ria
message: 「Well, I'll go first. Cheese fondue, wine, and fish and chips」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, could it be that the earthenware pot Senpai brought was used for cheese fondue?」

name: Ria
message: 「Sometimes, yeah. My big sister says it's too much hassle and just eats the powder straight, though」

name: Misa
message: 「Doesn't that defeat the whole point of cheese fondue...」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, let me guess... the wine is Beaujolais Nouveau?」

name: Ria
message: 「Amazing, how'd you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because that's the only one he knows」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't think Beaujolais has been released yet this year, though...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Which means it doesn't taste good yet. How disappointing」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No, that's not what I meant\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「My big sister often drinks it and eats that stuff on the side with fish and chips」

name: Synn
message: 「That sure sounds like it'd make you thirsty. Fried fish and french fries」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's called fish and chips」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When it comes to fish, I won't lose either. I brought Mr. Octopus and Mr. Tuna」

name: Synn
message: 「Is an octopus a fish?」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, even jellyfish are called 'fish' in English, so...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's one lively octopus you've got there!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, it's a live octopus!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ugh... that's kind of grotesque」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I think the way it squirms around is quite adorable, though」

name: Synn
message: 「We're going to cook and eat that now, you know」

name: Lolotte
message: 「H-How cruel!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's delicious, though」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, it can't be helped」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte-san. I get it, so could you put that away before it escapes?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And so, we're just gonna ignore the tuna?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it was totally obvious ever since we were at the school gate」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, I'm up next!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Clap, clap」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hype me up a little more!」

name: Synn
message: 「Woo-hoo!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Forget it. Mine is sobagaki」

name: Misa
message: 「Soba... gaki?」

name: Ria
message: 「Aha, so Nanaka-chan's family soba shop must have a lot of confidence in their buckwheat flour」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How can you tell?」

name: Ria
message: 「I think sobagaki is the dish that brings out the aroma of buckwheat the best」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You really know your stuff! It's even more fragrant than when it's made into noodles」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh~ I've never really paid much attention to the aroma of soba」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, me neither」

name: Nanaka
message: 「People like you guys are what make it worth making!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Do your best」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That leaves only the Vice President」

name: Misa
message: 「Umm, mine is――」

name: Synn
message: 「A curry set」

name: Misa
message: 「No it isn't!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Potatoes, carrots, onions, chicken.

name: Nanaka
message: Wait, you don't even have the crucial curry powder! Calling this a curry set is laughable」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm telling you, it's not!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I love curry!\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「I said it's not!」

name: Ria
message: 「Do you like curry, Misa-chan?」

name: Misa
message: 「I keep telling you, it's not curry...\s06」

name: Synn
message: 「So we're using all of this to make curry hotpot...」

name: Misa
message: 「Forget it, whatever...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't give up right there! This is a bona fide mystery hotpot!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How exciting! It looks like it's going to be delicious!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha\s02 I sure hope so」
